name: National Executive Database
description: The National Executive Database (NED) (v. 2) compiles data on national executives in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico from 1983 to 2026. Produced by the Subnational Politics Project (SPP) team, the database includes information on national executives' names, gender, party affiliation, reelection status, ideological orientation, partisan alignment with the national government, and other relevant attributes.

name: Subnational Executive Database
description: The Subnational Executive Database (SED) (v. 2) compiles data on subnational executives in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico from 1983 to 2026. Produced by the Subnational Politics Project (SPP) team, the database includes information on subnational executives' names, gender, party affiliation, reelection status, ideological orientation, partisan alignment with the national government, and other relevant attributes.

name: Subnational Executive Elections Database
description: The Subnational Executive Elections Database (SEED) (v. 2) compiles data on subnational executive elections in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico from 1983 to 2026. Produced by the Subnational Politics Project (SPP) team, the database includes information on winning candidates at the subnational level, percentage of votes obtained by the winner, runner-up, and last-place candidates, election date, number of registered voters, valid and invalid votes, number of parties in contest, the effective number of parties (ENP), and other relevant attributes.

name: Subnational Legislative Elections Database
description: The Subnational Legislative Elections Database (SLED) (v. 2) compiles data on subnational legislative elections in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico from 1983 to 2026. Produced by the Subnational Politics Project (SPP) team, the database includes information on parties competing in legislative elections, number of votes obtained by party, number of seats, election date, effective number of parties (ENP), number of registered voters, and number of valid, null, and blank votes, among other relevant attributes.

name: Subnational Democracy Indices
description: The Subnational Democracy Index (SDI) (v. 2) compiles data on subnational democracy in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico from 1983 to 2026. Produced by the Subnational Politics Project (SPP) team, the database includes a subnational democracy index as developed by Agustina Giraudy (2015).

name: Capital Federal & Tierra del Fuego Legislatures Database
description: The Capital Federal & Tierra del Fuego Legislatures Database (CFTDFLD) (v. 1) compiles data on subnational legislative elections in Capital Federal and Tierra del Fuego (Argentina) between 1983 and 1996.
